description: An exceptional and confidential leadership opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) in Baltimore County, MD. Join a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center committed to providing outstanding patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff. This role offers a chance to lead a dynamic team and make a significant impact on the facility's success and community well-being.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall operational management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and upholding the highest quality of care. This position is ideal for a visionary leader with a passion for healthcare excellence and a proven track record in long-term care administration. We offer a highly competitive salary range of $115,000 to $145,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this critical leadership role.
requirements: Current and active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage facility operations, staff, and resident care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.
